Professional Summary Accomplished EDUCATION CONSULTANT AND COUNSELOR and former Assistant Professor with 15+ years of extensive experience in academic mentorship, student career mapping, and strategic enrollment management. Proven expert in high-impact academic counseling with a core specialization in ENGINEERING ADMISSIONS, alongside Medical, Masters, and Undergraduate (UG) programs. Dedicated to transforming student aspirations into successful career pathways through expert guidance and trusted consulting.

Core Competencies & Expertise

Expert Education Consultant & Counselor: A trusted mentor specializing in identifying student potential, managing parent expectations, and providing data-driven career counseling.

Engineering Admission Specialist: Deep expertise in technical education counseling, entrance exam navigation, and securing admissions in premier engineering colleges
